{{Quote|What would you give for a little peace and quiet? How about 300 credits? That's all it takes to own a sound negation system from Paretaine.|Paretaine Sonics advertising|<ref name="GFT" />}}
The '''SNS-600''', also known as the '''sound bubble''', was a [[Sound-dampening field|sound negation system]] produced by [[Paretaine Sonics]]. It created a dampening field inside of which distracting ambient noises wouldn't be heard.

==Overview==
The SNS-600 sound bubble was created by [[Paretaine Sonics]], a company that specialized in sonic technology. In passive mode, this device generated a 360-degree field in a five-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] radius. Sounds emitted outside of the "bubble" could not be heard inside of it. In active mode, a 60-degree arc was produced out to ten meters. Sound waves were dampened within this arc, preventing aural vibration form being heard, whether by live or automated detectors.<ref name="GFT" />
